prose: The futurist & guide to Human Design, Ashley Mosaic, joins InnerVerse to discuss the insights she's gained from astrological foresight. We discuss how the transits of 2020 helped her see and prepare for what was coming for the world, and the most effective ways to benefit from paying attention to the sky clock, how Human Design is the compass to the map of your stars, the role of Mars in HD and other aspects of the body chart, and how Ashley helps clients by fusing HD with analytical foresight to make them more effective in their livelihoods.
ext: We consider what it means to be a futurist, the forecast for 2027 to 2030, an honest look at what's probably coming down the pike with blockchain and crypto, the energetic keys to financially thriving, where self-worth and abundance intersect in the Biofield, the aesthetics of success, the philosophy of getting started, and using ChatGPT to deep dive your own life story.
